■ The attached creature gets "powered breaker". (A creature that has "powered breaker" breaks an additional shield for each 6000 power.)
■ After the attached creature attacks, gacharange summon once for each other aura attached to it. Then attach each of those aura to a gacharange creature summoned this way.
